label: sec:confinement-selection-confinement-sdp-vs-preamble
html: This subsection isolates the categorical confinement-selection mechanism. The SDP-vs-LP comparison identifies which substrate-level constraints survive the LP relaxation. The multi-input SDP records the multi-particle confinement condition. The topological confinement provides the categorical no-decay obstruction. Finally, the LP-dual stability analysis fixes the substrate-flow behaviour. The closing blocks specialise to the n = 1 vacuous-magic case and connect the confinement selection to the SDP-as-thimble flow.
